entities.summary: Brooke Queenan is an American retired professional basketball player. She played the power forward position, last for WBC Bnot Hertzeliya in Israel. With ŽKK Partizan she won national Championship (2012–13), national Cup (2012–13) and Adriatic League Women (2012–13).
